versions.content: Service Name Bfx_CountLeadingSigns_<TypeMn> Syntax uint8 Bfx_CountLeadingSigns_<TypeMn> ( <Type> Data ) Service ID [hex] 0x102 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Data Input data Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value uint8 Bit position Description Count the number of consecutive bits which have the same value as most significant bit in Data, starting with bit at position msb minus one. Put the result in Data. It is the number of leading sign bits minus one, giving the number of redundant sign bits in Data. Available via Bfx.h
